name: dsh-plugin-afp
description: AFP photo curation for DSH Agents: resumable visual dry-runs and approved private-collection writes

prompt.en: Check AFP setup and private collection counts with afp_status and afp_collections. Do not modify AFP.
prompt.zh: 请用 afp_status 和 afp_collections 检查 AFP 配置和私有收藏夹数量，不修改远端。

prompt.en: Run an AFP food visual dry-run, collect the job result, and show the report. Do not write AFP.
prompt.zh: 请对 AFP 食物分类执行视觉筛选 dry-run，收集后台任务结果并展示报告，不写入 AFP。

description.en: Plan searches and inspect private collections.
description.zh: 规划图片检索，读取私有收藏夹数量。

details.en: Provides afp_status, afp_search_plan and afp_collections. Search planning is offline; collection reads require an AFP token or account credentials. No remote modifications.
details.zh: 提供 afp_status、afp_search_plan 和 afp_collections。搜索规划离线运行；读取收藏夹需要 AFP token 或账号凭据。不会修改远端。

description.en: Run resumable visual screening with saved reports.
description.zh: 执行可续跑的视觉筛选，保存检查点与报告。

details.en: Starts afp_refresh_run background jobs for chosen photo categories. Requires AFP credentials and a configured vision endpoint, model and key. Enforces execution budgets, retains checkpoints on cancellation, and never writes collections.
details.zh: 通过 afp_refresh_run 为选定图片分类启动后台任务。需要 AFP 凭据及视觉接口、模型和密钥。按预算执行，取消后保留检查点；筛选过程不会写入收藏夹。

description.en: Preview and confirm append, replace or clear operations.
description.zh: 预览并确认追加、替换或清空收藏夹。

details.en: Enables afp_apply (plans use afp_plan_change). Checks the account, exact private target, run and collection membership before writing. Agent writes require DSH approval; page writes require a one-use expiring preview confirmation. Failures may leave partial changes without automatic rollback or retry.
details.zh: 启用 afp_apply（计划由 afp_plan_change 生成）。写入前核对账户、精确私有目标、刷新记录和收藏夹成员。Agent 写入通过 DSH 确认；页面写入须确认具有有效期且仅可使用一次的预览。失败可能留下部分修改，不自动回滚或重试。

description.en: Open the shared AFP workbench from Settings.
description.zh: 在设置侧栏显示 AFP 操作台。

details.en: Registers settings.section. Uses the same profile tasks and unsent forms as the other entries; hiding this entry does not cancel tasks.
details.zh: 注册 settings.section。与其他入口共用当前 profile 的任务和未提交表单；隐藏入口不会取消任务。

description.en: Open AFP from the home global panel sidebar.
description.zh: 在首页全局面板侧栏显示 AFP 入口。

details.en: Registers sidebar.panellist and main. Removing the active entry returns to an available page. Task execution continues when navigating away.
details.zh: 注册 sidebar.panellist 和 main。关闭当前入口后回到可用页面；离开页面不停止任务。

description.en: Display a profile workbench tab in conversations.
description.zh: 在会话页显示 AFP 操作台标签。

details.en: Registers conversation.view for existing conversations. Shows the current profile workbench, not a separate Session task queue. Agent jobs keep their Session owner and use Session cancellation.
details.zh: 通过 conversation.view 在已有会话中显示标签。展示当前 profile 的操作台，不单独创建会话任务队列；Agent 任务仍属于原会话，通过会话取消。

description.zh: 指导按新闻主题与时间规划图片检索。

details.en: Guide timely news-photo searches. Installs a packaged Skill that guides the AFP tools. The Skill alone does not enable execution or remote writes. Shared DSH Home holders retain edited content when disabled; no user-owned Skill is overwritten.
details.zh: 指导按新闻主题与时间规划图片检索。 注入包内 Skill，用于指导调用 AFP 工具。Skill 本身不会启用执行或远端写入。多个 profile 共用 DSH Home；最后一个持有者停用后保留含用户修改的副本，不覆盖用户已有 Skill。
